_note: Seed baseline. Written by hand from the Phase 2 README's documented example scorecard (a live --repeats 5 run was never executed in this environment - no Qdrant instance or LLM provider credentials are configured here; see README 'Noise floor methodology'). safety.fabrications is set to 0 here (not the 1 shown in that illustrative README example) because the fabrications gate rule is max_absolute=0: a baseline that already contains a known fabrication would make every future candidate fail that rule regardless of whether it introduced a new one. This file is replaced automatically by .github/workflows/update-baseline.yml the first time a change merges to main with real evaluation credentials configured as repository secrets. Until then, eval-pr.yml compares every PR against these placeholder numbers, which still exercises the gate correctly - it just isn't measuring the real system yet.
